Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone body art for Yantai's 草编（莱州草辫）, Laizhou wheat-straw braiding; not a webpage or a new first-screen background.

Create ONE original wheat-straw appliqué and fine-braid material illustration. Combine several slender, slightly raised plaits with angular flat straw-mosaic pieces into a compact upright folded fan or sprig. The weave is artistic invention, not a tutorial or authenticated Laizhou pattern. No bulky reed strips, round woven ring, wicker basket, shell inlay or water landscape.

Clearly different from light ink painting: tactile cut-straw marquetry, crisp geometric edge rhythms, shallow relief shadows and directional fibre lustre on a matte muted mulberry/plum ground. Restrained honey-gold, pale straw and warm umber accents; no blue river-map paper layers, orange terracotta estuary collage, charcoal stage spotlight or glossy luxury jewellery. Contemporary cultural material art, not a real product photo, archaeological object, specific artist's work or copy of a named design.

Make a coherent compact wheat-braid motif that can be seen intact in a mobile4:5 view; do not sprawl into a wide horizontal ribbon or circular wreath.
No tools, hands, faces, scenery, step-by-step construction, technical arrows, museum identity or branding.
Absolutely no text, letters, Chinese characters, signatures, calligraphy, seals, logos, watermark or pseudo-writing. No frame, board, device, UI, multiple panels or mockup.
